Pricing

Auto-calculates breakeven, profit & bank settlement

SELECT SKU
— Choose a SKU —
Pricing Formula Reference
CR Cost
platform.cr_charge × (cr_percentage / 100)
Damage Cost
price × (damage_percentage / 100)
Breakeven
price + package + logistics + addons + misc + cr_cost + damage_cost
Net Profit
breakeven × (profit_percentage / 100)
BS w/o GST
round(breakeven + net_profit)
Bank Settlement
bs_wo_gst + round(bs_wo_gst × gst_rate / 100)
